job: G1 CPU benchmark and lightweight training run (resumable trainer)

environment.cpu: Intel Xeon @ 2.80 GHz, 4 vCPUs (AVX-512 VNNI), no GPU

data.view: var/training/g1/views/bench6k: seeded random sample (seed 20261018) of the G1 manifests, 6,000 train / 800 development images, stored at 320 px

download.note: original Open Images files streamed from open-images-dataset S3, resized with a JPEG draft decode

data.leakage_control: inherited from train-prep g1: photographers of every evaluation set are excluded from training; development is a photographer-grouped split

problems_found_and_fixed.problem: Model Maker 0.2.1.4's COCO cache writer skips every image without a box: 518 of the 707 hard-negative training images (confusable animals, dolls) and 53 development images of this view were silently dropped; at full scale most of the 6,045 hard negatives G1 selects would never be trained on
problems_found_and_fixed.fix: training/g1/train_resumable.py install_coco_writer(): keeps images without boxes (empty box lists); cache layout coco-v2-negatives-crowd; tests/test_g1_data_loader.py

problems_found_and_fixed.problem: the same writer does not store is_crowd, so the training-time validation scored Open Images group-of boxes as ordinary boxes although its docstring said they were ignored
problems_found_and_fixed.fix: is_crowd written to the cache; training is unchanged (Model Maker's preprocessor trains on group-of boxes as ordinary boxes and uses is_crowd only for evaluation ground truth)

problems_found_and_fixed.problem: boxes touching the right or bottom edge could exceed the image width by one rounding step after the normalised-to-pixel conversion and were dropped by Model Maker (15 train and 2 development boxes in this view)
the export step crashed on its first real use: Model Maker's save_tflite does not create the export directory
problems_found_and_fixed.fix: train_resumable.py creates run/export before exporting; the run was recovered by re-running the same command, which restored the final checkpoint, skipped training and exported

problems_found_and_fixed.problem: tensorflow-metadata 1.21 in the G1 lock needs protobuf>=5, which TensorFlow 2.15 excludes; tensorflow_datasets failed to import (Model Maker swallowed the error)

benchmark_contended_note: a second benchmark ran while E22 extracted features on the same 4 cores: training 9.2-12.6 images/s; not used for planning

benchmark_stock_loader.note: same view with Model Maker's original COCO writer, before the hard-negative fix; E22 was streaming (low CPU) during this run

lightweight_run.initialisation: Model Maker's COCO-trained RetinaNet checkpoint (backbone, decoder, head convolutions); classifier re-initialised for the 14 G1 classes
lightweight_run.history_note: epochs 1-3 shared the CPU with E21 / E21b audio scoring part of the time, so their images_per_second is below the idle benchmark; epoch 1 was interrupted and resumed

recovery_tests.sigterm: SIGTERM to the trainer during epoch 1: it finished the current step, wrote checkpoint ckpt-2 (reason 'signal', epoch 1, step 82 of 375, optimizer iteration 457) and exited cleanly
recovery_tests.changed_config_refused: re-running with --batch-size 8 exited with 'refusing to resume: configuration or data changed'
recovery_tests.resume: re-running the original command printed resumed_from ckpt-2 at epoch 1 step 82 and continued with optimizer iteration 458; data order replayed exactly (augmentation draws may differ, as documented in the trainer)
recovery_tests.export_crash_recovery: after the export crash, re-running the command restored the epoch-4 checkpoint, skipped training and wrote all three exports
